## Topics

Using GitHub and Copilot AI to manage, automate and publish your repository. A demo where we create a GitHub repository with:

- Automated tests of the code
- An automated workflow for publishing as a webpage
- Version upgrades for packages
- Container publication
- Secret variables

All this with the help of GitHub Copilot, which can create automations in repositories very effectively.
